source: MATLAB 25.1.0.2943329 (R2025a) spectrumAnalyzer captures (scope_capture/out, run 2026-10-24) — only the configuration, the scope's measurement numbers, the input-signal reference and a few sampled display bins are kept here; the displayed spectra are rebuilt from the research signals (tests/matlab_ref/obw_chpower/in_x_*.txt) with the identified model

spectrum_model.trace_used: normal trace of the last call (also when PlotMaxHoldTrace is on)

measurement_rule.psd: trace/RBW in power mode; the trace itself in power-density mode
measurement_rule.integration: PSD piecewise constant, bin k covers [f_k-df/2, f_k+df/2] including the first/last bin; C(f) = exact integral
measurement_rule.frequency_error: (f_lo+f_hi)/2 - CF; CF = CenterFrequency (span mode) or (Start+Stop)/2 (start/stop mode)
measurement_rule.outside: a < f_first or b > f_last -> ChannelPower, OccupiedBW, FrequencyError all NaN, no error

auto_span_rule.trigger: unresolved (applied in obw_real_1s_autospan_defaults, not in acpr_cplx_2s_autospan_defaults)
